content.short: Almanax is an AI Security Engineer fixing code vulnerabilities.
content.description: Security testing for Web3 code increasingly relies on external audits, but traditional static analyzers remain rule-based and frequently miss complex logical bugs. Almanax leverages large language models to scan a codebase for subtle, logic-driven vulnerabilities that are hard to capture with fixed rules. It analyzes how code behaves and how data moves across modules, highlighting issues that might escape standard checks. Almanax supports Aptos, Base, Ethereum, Solana, Polygon, BNB Chain, and Cosmos, and is used by many Web3 projects as part of internal testing before an audit.
